name: Path of the Berserker
description: For some barbarians, rage is a means to an end — that end being violence. The Path of the Berserker is a path of untrammeled fury, slick with blood.

features.name: Frenzy
features.description: While raging, you can choose to enter a frenzy that lets you make a single melee weapon attack as a Bonus Action on each of your turns after the first.

features.name: Mindless Rage
features.description: You can't be Charmed or Frightened while raging.

name: College of Lore
description: Bards of the College of Lore know something about most things, gathering bits of stories, lore, and humor from across the realms.

features.name: Bonus Proficiencies
features.description: Gain proficiency with three skills of your choice.

features.name: Cutting Words
features.description: Use a Reaction to expend Bardic Inspiration and subtract that die from a creature's attack roll, ability check, or damage roll.

name: Life Domain
description: The Life domain focuses on the vibrant positive energy that sustains all life. Clerics of life are masters of healing, succor, and recovery.

features.name: Bonus Proficiency
features.description: Gain proficiency with Heavy Armor.

features.name: Disciple of Life
features.description: Whenever you use a spell of 1st level or higher to restore Hit Points to a creature, the creature regains additional Hit Points equal to 2 + the spell's level.

name: Circle of the Land
description: Druids of the Circle of the Land are mystics and sages who safeguard ancient knowledge and rites through a vast oral tradition.

features.name: Circle Spells
features.description: You learn additional spells based on the type of land where you became a druid (arctic, coast, desert, forest, grassland, mountain, swamp, or Underdark).

features.name: Land's Aid
features.description: Use a magical action to cause a 10-foot-radius sphere of healing energy at a point you can see; allies regain Hit Points and enemies take radiant damage.

name: Champion
description: The archetypal Champion focuses on raw physical power honed to deadly perfection. Those who model themselves on this archetype combine rigorous training with physical excellence.

features.name: Improved Critical
features.description: Your weapon attacks score a critical hit on a roll of 19 or 20.

features.name: Remarkable Athlete
features.description: Add half your Proficiency Bonus (rounded up) to any Strength, Dexterity, or Constitution check that doesn't already use it.

name: Warrior of the Open Hand
description: Monks of the Open Hand are masters of unarmed combat, learning techniques to push and trip their opponents and to harness ki to deal damage and protect their bodies.

features.name: Open Hand Technique
features.description: When you hit with an attack from your Martial Arts feature, you can impose one of: knock prone, push 15 feet, or no Reactions until end of next turn.

features.name: Quivering Palm
features.description: Spend Focus Points (or ki) to set up vibrations in a creature's body that you can later use to deal massive necrotic damage.

name: Oath of Devotion
description: The Oath of Devotion binds a paladin to the loftiest ideals of justice, virtue, and order — the classic knight in shining armor.

features.name: Sacred Weapon
features.description: Use Channel Divinity: for 1 minute your weapon glows with sacred power, adding your Charisma modifier to attack rolls and emanating bright light.

features.name: Aura of Devotion
features.description: You and friendly creatures within 10 feet can't be Charmed while you're conscious.

name: Hunter
description: Embracing the role of a peerless hunter of monsters, you learn specialized techniques to take down the most dangerous foes — be they giants, dragons, or fiends.

features.name: Hunter's Prey
features.description: Choose one option: Colossus Slayer (extra damage to wounded foes), Giant Killer (reaction strike against Large+), or Horde Breaker (attack a second target nearby).

features.name: Defensive Tactics
features.description: Choose one defensive option to specialize in (Escape the Horde, Multiattack Defense, or Steel Will).

name: Thief
description: You hone your skills in larceny and quick-fingered exploration. The classic agile burglar archetype — equally comfortable plundering a tomb or scaling a sheer wall.

features.name: Fast Hands
features.description: You can use your Cunning Action to make a Sleight of Hand check, use thieves' tools, or take the Use an Object action.

features.name: Second-Story Work
features.description: Climbing no longer costs you extra movement, and you can make a long jump after a 5-foot run-up of distance up to your Dexterity modifier (in feet) farther than normal.

name: Draconic Sorcery
description: Your innate magic comes from a draconic ancestry, granting you scales, claws, and elemental power. As you grow, your dragon heritage manifests more strongly.

features.name: Draconic Resilience
features.description: Your maximum Hit Points increase by 3 and increase by 1 each time you gain a Sorcerer level. Your AC equals 13 + Dex modifier when not wearing armor.

features.name: Elemental Affinity
features.description: Add your Charisma modifier to one damage roll of a spell that deals damage of the type associated with your draconic ancestry.

name: Fiend Patron
description: You have made a pact with a fiend from the lower planes — a powerful devil or demon. Your patron's name might be whispered to you in dreams or burned into your flesh.

features.name: Dark One's Blessing
features.description: When you reduce a hostile creature to 0 Hit Points, you gain temporary Hit Points equal to your Charisma modifier + your Warlock level (minimum 1).

features.name: Dark One's Own Luck
features.description: Once per short or long rest, add a d10 to one ability check or saving throw after rolling, potentially turning a failure into a success.

name: Evoker
description: You focus your study on magic that creates powerful elemental effects: bitter cold, searing flame, rolling thunder, crackling lightning, and burning acid. The classic blaster archetype.

features.name: Sculpt Spells
features.description: When you cast an Evocation spell with a chosen area, you can protect a number of allies equal to 1 + the spell's level — they automatically succeed on saves and take no damage.

features.name: Potent Cantrip
features.description: When a creature succeeds on a saving throw against your cantrip, the creature still takes half the damage (if any) but suffers no other effect.
